notes.title: v2.2.0 Landing Mechanics, New Animations, Gamefeel Effects & More!
notes.content: [p]Ciao, we are uploading a new build to Steam and Itch![/p][p]Would be very curious to hear what you think, especially for the game feel, new landings and the dash.[/p][p]Send us feedback in the comments here or on our [url="https://discord.gg/CPvzd4SJxC"]discord[/url] server![/p][p][/p][h1][b]Biggest Changes[/b][/h1][p][b]Red Guy (Character Model)[/b][/p][list][*][p]  Red Guy, who was turned into Grey Guy, is now Red again.[/p][/*][*][p]  Red Guy has clothes now. (1st iteration of the new model)[/p][/*][*][p]  Red Guy got new animations.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Landing States[/b][/p][list][*][p]    (Press SHIFT or CTRL/C just before you hit the ground).[/p][/*][*][p]    You can now roll or slap the ground to maintain momentum.[/p][/*][*][p]    You can stumble or become stunned if you fall too far.[/p][/*][*][p]    Hold CTRL/C to go into a slide instead. Doesn't work if you fall too far (you will roll instead).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gamefeel[/b][/p][list][*][p]    New 'Gamefeel Intensity' slider in options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]    New speedlines and blurring that happens when you move fast. (Very Mirrors Edge inspired).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Dashing[/b][/p][list][*][p]    Press SHIFT + A or D to dash.[/p][/*][*][p]    Very Mirrors Edge inspired.[/p][/*][*][p]    Puts you to max speed immediately.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Air Coiling / Crouch Jumping[/b][/p][list][*][p]    Press CTRL/C while in the air to crouch jump.[/p][/*][*][p]    Makes your collider smaller.[/p][/*][*][p]    Gives you a tiny upwards boost.[/p][/*][*][p]    Not that much use right now. But it feels cool?.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Movement Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]    When wall climbing, you now pause for a moment at the top before you start sliding down.[/p][/*][*][p]    When wall climbing, when you start sliding down you can reach a higher max speed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]    Catacombs level: Fixed the lighting breaking on low and medium settings.[/p][/*][*][p]    Catacombs level: Lighting should be more performant.[/p][/*][*][p]    Minor material and texture changes for flooded and catacombs level.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Known Issues[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Camera clips into the model when you roll.,[/p][/*][*][p]Slapping the ground twice in a row makes you very short.,[/p][/*][*][p]Tapping CTRL just before landing can play the slide animation for a brief moment.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]All Other Changes![/b][/h1][h2][b]UI Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Drop down settings are now opaque instead of translucent.,[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Animations[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Landing animations added.[/p][list][*][p]Rolling.[/p][list][*][p]Ground slap.,[/p][/*][*][p]Rough landing (stumble).,[/p][/*][*][p]Hard landing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dash animations added.[/p][/*][*][p]Running animation improvements.[/p][list][*][p]Hips should sway more, should feel smoother overall.[/p][list][*][p]Each run direction has a unique look.[/p][/*][*][p]Arms should look more natural when you look up or down.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Wall climb animation improvements.[/p][list][*][p]Hands are more visible, should help with understanding what is happening.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added crouch jumping animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Small improvements to crouching animation transitions.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Camera Shakes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Re-introduced some camera shakes. More to come.[/p][/*][*][p]Don't want people to get motion sick so adding them slowly and keeping them weak.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Graphics[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added first iteration of character.[/p][/*][*][p]Added post processing (gamefeel).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed catacombs lighting breaking on medium and low settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched up some holes in catacombs.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Optimisations,[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Optimised textures. - they should take 30-50% less memory and result in ~10% better FPS.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inverted normals on brick textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Master Materials. - about 3% less complex should give better FPS and load faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for parallax mapping - this is disabled if materials are set lower than "high".[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked catacombs lighting to be more performant.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Environments[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved lighting in flooded level.[/p][/*][*][p]Added parallax mapping to bricks - depends on graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased brick normal map intensity by ~50% - thought it looked more hand-painted.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked catacombs texturing - brighter colors make the lighting less dark.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed some situations where your camera could get stuck tilted.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Boars in Rome Playtest is Live!
notes.content:
Hello!

Thank you for trying out our playtest. This is a version that we showcased live at Dutch AnimeCon.

Everything you see is still work in progress but we hope you have fun with it! There are 2 levels:
[list]
[*] Catacombs (Tutorial + Underground Area)
[*] Flooded City (More polished city envrironment)
[/list]

Please let us know how things go. We'd love to hear your thoughts and see your stylish clips on [url=https://discord.gg/Hq8j2J3kCa]discord[/url], as a reply to this post, or in the community hub :)

Note: the Flooded City level is better optimised than the Catacombs. If you run into performance issues, please let us know!
